Commentary.Commentary: So that ends the proceedings of this match. It was a good test for both the sides going into the Champions Trophy. India came out on top, outclassing New Zealand in all the three departments of the game. India play their next warm-up game on 30th May, 2017 against Bangladesh at the Oval while New Zealand play against Sri Lanka in Birmingham on the same day. Till then, it's goodbye from us. Take care! Cheers!

Kohli and Dhawan added 68 runs for the second wicket and put India in a commanding position. The Kiwis, however, made their way back in the game with a couple of quick blows. MS Dhoni then came out and calmed the nerves, ticking along nicely with the skipper before the rain gods decided to play spoilsport. The Black Caps could have made further damage to the Indians had they not dropped some crucial catches at crunch times.

Coming back to the match, New Zealand were way off the mark with the bat. Only Luke Ronchi and Jimmy Neesham showed some resistance and helped their side post a total of 189. However, their bowlers started off beautifully and kept the Indian openers on their feet. Ajinkya Rahane fell early but Shikhar Dhawan stood tall in the middle with his skipper Virat Kohli.
Bad news folks, the weather has played spoilsport in this contest as the rain kept on tumbling down. There won't be any further play and INDIA HAVE WON BY 45 RUNS according to the DLS method.

UPDATE 1630 LOCAL TIME - The rain has not stopped yet and more covers have been brought on. If the match is being called off, then India are ahead of the par DLS score by 45 runs. There will be an update from the Oval at 1700 local time.

PLAY HALTED - The rain picked up in the last over and so the umpires have decided to leave the ground, signaling for the covers to be brought on. India need 61 runs off 144 deliveries with 7 wickets in hand. Let's hope it's a passing shower and play resumes as soon as possible. Stay tuned for more updates.

LBW Shout! Pitched on a length around off, angling in, Dhoni walks down the track and looks to flick it away but misses and gets rapped on the pads. The players appeal but it's turned down by umpire Dar. The ball rolls to fine leg and a leg bye is taken.
The rain has started to get heavy now!
Once again Dhoni walks across and lets it go.
The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact.
Pitched outside off, Dhoni gets across and leaves it.
Length delivery outside off, punched through cover-point for a single.
Good away swing! Pitched outside off, Kohli looks to drive it but gets beaten by the ball swinging away.
Tim Southee back into the attack.
Length delivery outside off, defended on the off side.
FOUR! That's struck hard! Back of a length delivery outside off, Dhoni makes full use of the width on offer as he slaps it past a diving Guptill at backward point for a boundary.
Pitched outside off, driven straight to short cover.

DROPPED AND A SIX! Back of a length delivery wide outside off, Dhoni slaps it powerfully over cover-point and finds the fielder who was just placed there. But de Grandhomme there makes a mess of it as he looks to take a reverse cup catch. The ball spills off his hands over the fence for a maximum. After seeing that, Dhoni has a smile on his face, Kohli has a smile on his face and so does Kane Williamson. The Black Caps haven't been good on the field today.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
Length delivery outside off, punched to covers.
Short and wide outside off, Dhoni looks to slash it with hard hands but gets an outside edge just short of third man for a single.
Wide! Banged in short, Dhoni pulls out of his shot. The umpire signals wide for an overhead bouncer.

Huge shout for lbw! Good length delivery, angling in. Dhoni walks across and forward, looks to flick it away but misses and gets rapped on the pad. The players appeal loudly but the umpire turns it down. There are no reviews as it's a warm-up game.
Length delivery outside off, Dhoni walks ahead a touch and pushes it to covers.
Pitched outside off, glided to third man for a single.
Fifty for Virat Kohli

Slightly overpitched outside off, Kohli drives it neatly through covers. The outfield is slightly on the slower side and Milne in the deep, covers good ground and then dives to make the vital stop. Kohli looks for the third but as he turns, he slips and so they both settle for a couple.
On a length around off, punched to mid on.
Banged in short by Boult. It's well directed as well and Dhoni gets out of its way at the last moment.
Back of a length delivery, angling away, Dhoni pulls it through backward square leg for a brace.
Pitched outside off, left alone by MS.

FOUR! That just raced away to the fence! On a length and slanting away from Dhoni. He goes back and carves it past Guptill at backward point. It's not far from Patel in the deep but Dhoni timed it so well that Patel could only move a couple of yards to his right and see the ball cross the fence.
A touch back of a length delivery, slanting across. Dhoni gets on his toes and drags it front of square on the leg side.
Length delivery outside off, dabbed to third man for a single.
Once again Dhoni uses his feet and defends it on the bounce on the leg side.
Pitched outside off, Dhoni walks across and blocks it in covers.
Dhoni walks ahead to curb the swing and defends it on the off side.
Length delivery, angling in, tucked square of the wicket on the leg side for a single.
Pitched outside off, swinging away. Kohli watchfully leaves it.
On a length outside off, Kohli taps it in front of covers and looks for a quick single but is sent back.
MS Dhoni walks out to bat.
Drinks break!

OUT! Boult strikes! Short delivery, angling away, Karthik pulls it across the line. Tries to keep it down but finds Santner at short mid-wicket. The Kiwi spinner takes a good catch, crouching low to his left. Karthik departs for nought. It was very similar to the wicket of Dhawan's.
A touch behind length around off, slanting away, Karthik chops it behind square on the off side.
On a length and angling away, Karthik defends it solidly from within the crease.
Angling away from Karthik, he feels for it but gets beaten.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
It has started drizzling at the Oval. Let's hope it stops quickly.

DROPPED! Oh dear! That could have been a game-changing moment. Half-volley outside off, Kohli strides forward and drives it over covers. Santner at short extra cover, jumps full stretch, gets both his hands to it but fails to grab it. It was a very, very difficult chance. A single is taken off the drop.
Trent Boult is back on!
Trent Boult is back on!
Way outside off, Kartik lets the ball go through to the keeper.
Gets beaten for the third time in a row, back of a length ball, Kartik goes to defend it off the back foot but gets beaten on the outside.
A second slip now comes in.
Full and swinging away, Kartik goes for the drive but gets beaten again.
BEATEN! Length ball, moving away, Kathik pokes at it but gets beaten.
Full toss on leg stump, Kohli flicks it to deep square leg for a run.
FOUR! LUCKY! Full ball, outside away, swinging away, kohli gets an outside edge through the vacant slip area for a four.
Dinesh Karthik strides out to bat. He looks at the sky for a long time before entering the ground. Might be hoping for some blessings from the almighty.

OUT! New Zealand break the partnership! Short ball by Neesham, Dhawan slaps it but it goes straight into the hands of Anderson at short mid-wicket who takes a good catch. Can New Zealand build on this wicket?
Full, Kohli drives it through covers for a run.
Bowled on leg stump, Dhawan flicks it to fine leg for a run.
Length ball, Dhawan drives it on the covers but cant beat the fielder.
Short on the body, Neesham pulls it to fine leg for a run.
Walks down the wicket, Neesham bangs it in outside off, Kohli cuts it but gets an underedge to point.
Full ball, Kohli drives it to deep cover for a run.
Angles it into the pads, Dhawan flicks it down to fine leg for a run.
The floodlights are now switched on at the Oval.
Bowled outside off, Kohli guides it down to third man for a run.
Dances down the wicket, bowler bowls it short, Dhawan pulls it to deep square leg for a run.
Dhawan gives the charge and defends the length ball on the leg side.
Back of a length ball, Dhawan defends it off the back foot.
Back of a length ball, Dhawan pulls it to deep square leg for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Dhawan plays a very controlled pull shot, Neesham bowls it short on the body, Dhawan pulls it behind square on the leg side for a boundary. These two are going well.
Back of a length ball, Dhawan tucks it on the leg side.
Short ball, kohli jumps and guides it down to third man for a run.
Length ball, Kohli defends it off the front foot.
Runs it down to third man for a run.
Wide! Bowls it way outside off, the batsman goes after it but misses it and its called a wide.
50-run stand up between Kohli and Dhawan.
FOUR! EDGED! Bowls it outside off, Kohli tries to guide it down to third man but gets a thick outside edge and it goes through the vacant slip area for a boundary.
Comes down the track, flicks the length ball to mid-wicket.
That ball has taken the inside edge onto the pads. They pick up a single.
Length ball, Dhawan defends it from within the crease.
Angling into the pads, Dhawan misses the flick. The ball brushes his pads and goes fine and they run two leg byes.
Colin de Grandhomme is called into the attack.
That ball has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads.
Bowls it on the pads, Dhawan misses the flick, hits him on the thigh pad and rolls to square leg and they run for a leg bye.
Length ball gets extra bounce, Dhawan plays it to the point region.
Bowls it on a length, Dhawan defends it off the front foot.
Full and wide outside off, Kohli drives it beautifully through covers for a run.
Lands it on a length, Dhawan pushes it to cover-point for a run.
Jimmy Neesham comes into the attack.
Back of a length ball, Kohli blocks it off the back foot.
Short ball, Dhawan pulls it to mid-wicket for a run.
Back of a length ball, Dhawan defends it onto the ground.
Short and Dhawan cuts it straight to point.
Gets an inside edge on a length ball outside off, which goes to fine leg for a single.
Lands on a length, Kohli defends it off the front foot.
Change of gloves for Shikhar Dhawan.
Full and angling into Kohli. He times the on drive beautifully and gets it past a diving Boult at mid on. The outfield is a touch slow and the batsmen run three.
Back of a length ball, Kohli pushes it to mid-wicekt off the back foot.
Length ball, Kohli defends it on the front foot.
Wide of off stump, Dhawan cuts it to deep point for a run.
FOUR! EASY PICKINGS FOR DHAWAN! Short and wide of off stump, Dhawan jumps and upper cuts it to the left of third man for a boundary.
Drifts on the pads, Kohli flicks it to deep square leg for a run.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Back of a length outside off, Kohli guides it wide of slip, where Anderson dives and stops the ball. He has a shy at the striker's end but misses and they complete the run.
Bowls it short, Dhawan pulls it to deep square leg for a run.
Short and wide, Kohli cuts it to deep point for a run.
FOUR! Short on the body of Kohli, who comes inside the line and pulls it very fine into the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Strays on the pads, Dhawan flicks it behind square leg for a run.
Short and wide, Dhawan cuts it through the off side for a run.
Full outside off, Dhawan goes for a drive but gets an underedge which lobs to cover on the bounce.
Short of a length outside off, Dhawan cuts it straight to point.
Full on leg stump, Kohli goes to flick it but gets an inside edge to mid-wicket and they run through for a single.
Full ball on off, driven to mid off.
SNORTER! Well-directed short ball, Kohli goes for the pull shot but the ball is too quick for him.
Power Play 2 has been signalled. Four fielders are now allowed outside the circle till the 40th over.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Kohli places it in the point region. Neesham at point half-stops it and concedes a single.

FOUR! What just happened there? Back of a length wide outside off. Kohli latches onto the width on offer and cuts it hard towards backward point. Fails to keep it on the ground. Neesham in that region is slow to react and by the time he stretches his right hand, the ball races past him to the fence. Neesham should have done better there. Had he reacted early, it would have been a great opportunity to send Kohli back in the dressing room.
This time Kohli drives it straight to mid off.
FOUR! Top shot! Pitched on a good length outside off, Kohli takes a couple of steps ahead and just drives through the line. Beats mid off and the ball races to the fence. That's some shot!
Slightly full around off, Dhawan fails to drive it neatly through mid off but takes a quick single.
Full and swinging in, Dhawan makes room and looks to dig it out but misses and gets hit low on the pads.
Tim Southee is back into the attack.
FOUR! Straight and full around off, Kohli drives it past a diving Milne through mid on for a boundary. The replay shows that Milne got fingertips to it.
Full on middle, clipped straight to mid-wicket.
Length delivery, angling away from the southpaw. He waits for it and then taps it square on the off side. Neesham at point, gets on his toes and makes a good half-stop. A single is taken.
Short delivery, angling away, Dhawan mistimes his pull to mid on.
Another full delivery, Kohli looks to drive but gets a thick inside edge and the ball runs behind square on the leg side for a single.
Full and straight on middle and leg, Dhawan gets it off the inner half of the bat as he tries to flick it in the gap between mid-wicket and mid on for a single.
On the thigh pad, tucked to forward square leg.
Kohli stays in the crease and punches it to mid on.

Sharp bouncer from Boult! Banged in short, angling in. It's too quick for Dhawan and he fails to pull it away. The ball hits the grill of the helmet and runs on the leg side. A leg bye is taken. As Dhawan crosses, Boult makes sure if he is okay and both bump their fists. Good gesture, this!
Angling into the batsman, defended on the leg side.
Edged but short again! Pitched on a good length outside off, Dhawan looks to play with an angled bat but gets an outside edge which falls short of Anderson at first slip. Once again, Dhawan survives.
Almost a chop on! On a length around off, shaping away after pitching. Dhawan looks to play it late but ends up getting an inside edge to the keeper.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Back of a length around off, moves away slightly with extra bounce. Kohli gets on his toes to defend but gets squared up a touch and ends up getting it off the outer half to cover.
Back of a length delivery, angling in, Kohli gets on his toes and tucks it square of the wicket on the leg side for a brace.
Straight and angling in, defended with the angle to mid on.
Pitched outside off, shapes back in after crossing the batsman as he leaves it.
Full outside off, Kohli leans ahead and pushes it to cover-point.
Adam Milne comes into the attack.
Straying on the pads, Kohli nudges it to fine leg to get off the mark with a single.
Outside off, left alone.
Angling into the southpaw, worked on the leg side for a single.

Huge shout for lbw! On a length and angling in from outside off, Dhawan gets across and plays by bringing bat and pad close. Boult appeals for lbw but umpire Dar says not out, indicating impact to be outside off.
Beaten! On a good length on middle and off, swings away sharply. Dhawan looks to glide it away on the off side but gets beaten. This is good start from the Kiwis!
Pitched on a length on middle, shaping away, defended down the track. Boult has been getting a great deal of movement.
The players are back out in the middle. Virat Kohli and Shikhar Dhawan to continue their innings. Trent Boult to start the proceedings after the break. A short cover and a lone wide slip in place.

An absorbing five overs of cricket and New Zealand have managed to pick up a wicket in the form of Ajinkya Rahane. Southee and Boult bowled consistent lines and lengths and kept the Indian batsmen on their toes. There were some false shots induced but the Kiwis made a mistake by dropping Dhawan when he was on one. When you are defending a low total, you can't afford such mistakes. Can the Kiwis come out after the lunch break and take some quick wickets to pressurize the Indian batting or will the Men in Blue run away with the show?
Pitched around off, swinging away, Kohli defends it off the outer half in the point region. THAT WILL BE LUNCH!
The Indian skipper, Virat Kohli strides out to bat. A loud cheer for him by the Oval crowd.

OUT! Rahane holes out! Southee with the breakthrough! He bowls a short delivery, angling down leg. Rahane pulls it over behind square on the leg side but fails to get it off the meat. Boult at fine leg, moves a couple of steps ahead, kneels down and takes the catch with his fingers pointing upwards. Rahane's struggling innings comes to an end!
Rahane dances down the track, Southee spots that and bangs it short. Rahane then looks to pull it away but manages to connect thin air only.
Angling away from the southpaw, run down to third man for a single.
A touch ahead of length outside off, Rahane fails to time his drive through covers. Only a single is taken.
On a length and angling away, Dhawan waits for the ball to come to him and then glides it to third man for a single.
Pitched outside off, guided past backward point for a single.
FOUR! Top shot! Back of a length delivery, Dhawan gets in a good position and then cuts it square of the wicket for a boundary. He is looking good now after a nervy start!
Another outswinger by Boult, Dhawan lets it go.
Length delivery, angling in, defended by getting on toes.

Five Wides! Boult bangs it short but it's too short and the ball bounces over Dhawan, who jumps and looks to play the upper cut but misses. Even Ronchi behind the stumps fails to collect it. The ball races away to the fence and five wides is signalled!
Dhawan moves ahead to take the swing out of equation and then places it on the full towards point.
On a length and swinging away, left alone.
On a good length outside off, Jinx looks to defend by leaning ahead but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Banged in short, Rahane looks to pull but misses it completely. That was a good, well-directed bouncer!
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Southee gets his length wrong. Ends up bowling a full toss outside off and it's put away by Dhawan through covers for a boundary. That was a real gift!
Angling into the batsman and then the ball straightens a touch. Rahane looks to flick it on the leg side but gets a leading edge through covers for a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Edged but just short! Fuller length delivery in the line of the stumps, swinging away after pitching. Dhawan looks to defend but gets another outside edge. This time it falls short of Guptill at second slip. The Indian opener is living a charmed life! End of an eventful over from Boult.

FOUR! Edged and raced away! Outside off, swinging away again. Dhawan throws his bat at it, gets an outside edge and the ball flies past the slip cordon to the fence behind. Unlucky Boult, he should have had a wicket!
Wide outside off, left alone.

DROPPED! Back of a length delivery outside off, swinging away. Dhawan goes through with his favourite cut shot but hits it straight to Broom at point. The Kiwi, however drops it. Reprieve for Shikhar Dhawan! That can be a costly miss!
On a length outside off, Dhawan taps it to point.
Outside off, swinging away, Dhawan makes a watchful leave. The replays show that Boult took a tumble in his followthrough.
Trent Boult to bowl from the other new ball.
FOUR! Timing! Pitched up outside off, Rahane shifts his weight onto his front foot and creams his drive through the gap between mid off and covers for a boundary.
Wide! Angling down leg, Ajinkya looks to flick it but misses. A wide is signalled.
Outside off, pushed to mid off.
Angling into the batsman, straightens a touch after pitching. Rahane looks to play it on the leg side but gets it off the outer half back to the bowler.
Dhawan taps it in front of covers and takes a quick single to get off the mark. The fielder there fails to pick the ball cleanly.
Leg slip in place for Dhawan!

Edged but short! Pitched on a similar length, Rahane looks to play with a straight bat down the ground but ends up getting an outside edge as the ball straightens a touch. De Grandhomme at third slip, gets low to his right, stretches his right hand but the ball falls just short of him. The ball goes behind and a single is taken.
Now a third slip comes in place!
Swing straightaway! Pitched a touch ahead of good length, Rahane prods forward to push it but gets beaten by the late away swing. Superb start, this!
We are back for the chase. Shikhar Dhawan to open with Ajinkya Rahane. Tim Southee to start the proceedings with the ball. He has a couple of slips in place. Here we go...
